issue.title: fix(young): resolve overlapping event-poster and inline-image routes
issue.body:
The Young catalog has two public route patterns that both accept `/api/catalog/young-events/images/image`:

- `/api/catalog/young-events/[youngId]/image` resolves an event poster and returns a no-store 302 to the local immutable image URL.
- `/api/catalog/young-events/images/[...path]` serves an inline image through R2 and its upstream fallback.

An independent read-only audit of the compiled SvelteKit route table found the static `images` namespace is selected first, interpreting `image` as the image path. The existing event-ID schema permits any trimmed nonempty string; Prisma uses a string without a numeric constraint, and repository seed data contains nonnumeric event IDs. Consequently the current contract does not exclude an event whose ID is `images`. This ambiguity predates the Demo work; no production occurrence of that ID has been established.

## Required investigation and acceptance

- Reproduce with an owned database event whose ID is `images`, a safe local poster path, and an owned R2 object. Disable redirect following and prove which handler answers the exact request without contacting the external poster origin.
- Preserve ordinary event-poster lookup and existing immutable inline-image URLs, cache headers and conditional requests. Do not narrow the event-ID schema to numbers or rename public URLs merely to avoid the collision.
- Resolve the route ambiguity and add meaningful real-HTTP regression coverage for the colliding event, ordinary events and immutable images, with isolated cleanup and no external fetch.
- Check trusted Demo image boundaries as well as ordinary requests. Independently review the actual final route table and run relevant validation before merging.

Relevant source: `src/routes/api/catalog/young-events/images/[...path]/+server.ts`, `src/routes/api/catalog/young-events/[youngId]/image/+server.ts`, `src/lib/api/schemas/request-path-schemas.ts`, `src/lib/api/routes/young-event-routes.ts`, and `src/features/young/server/young-event-image-service.ts`.

## Confirmed owned HTTP result and compatible implementation

A fresh main `1fb350a9` Worker reproduced both resources simultaneously in an isolated database/R2 namespace. An ordinary event ID returned the expected no-store 302; its immutable poster returned the exact owned PNG and conditional 304. The colliding `/young-events/images/image` returned the other owned inline PNG with immutable caching and no Location header. The real outbound probe was empty; no upstream poster was fetched. This proves the collision, not a completed fix or a production occurrence.

Changing precedence would reinterpret an already valid immutable URL. The implementation will instead establish `/api/catalog/young-events/by-id/{youngId}/image` as the unambiguous canonical resolver, retain legacy and immutable behavior, and explicitly document the legacy overlap. Its three segments do not collide with the existing two-segment event resolver or the static `images` prefix. Existing Web/GraphQL/CLI/Bot/iOS display code correctly consumes immutable DTO `imageUrl` values and will keep doing so; it has no handwritten legacy resolver call to migrate. The actual by-ID contract is exposed through OpenAPI, generated clients, generic CLI API registration and protocol tests. Server protocol consumers will move to the canonical operation; generated client synchronization follows when that server contract is stable.

Acceptance must prove both the canonical colliding-ID 302 and the unchanged legacy inline 200, plus ordinary/immutable/conditional/HEAD and trusted Demo isolation. Do not report that the old ambiguous URL has become an event redirect. Server implementation is now in PR #1553 (`5e1aeb88526ae2fae6f5d42bca944b7dd65d52fe`), independently reviewed and validated with 191 related units and five real HTTP cases. Both `images` and `by-id` have canonical GET/HEAD redirect controls, while legacy `by-id` still redirects and the old ambiguous inline URI keeps its original bytes/cache. The current-head workflow and all 47 checks passed; PR #1553 is now merged as `735f06b00d0a6067cbcc5fdfd0761103747f8782` with the reviewed tree unchanged. The server canonical resolver is delivered. This issue remains OPEN for main-based generated-client synchronization; existing immutable display URLs are unchanged.


## Generated consumer delivery — complete

Server PR #1553 merged as `735f06b00d0a6067cbcc5fdfd0761103747f8782` after all 47 checks passed. The independently reviewed tree matches the actual merge tree.

Both companions are also merged: [CLI #118](https://github.com/Life-USTC/cli/pull/118) at `d5976621e9da1bb1e20ccae7684dab8f2e4498c8` after 4/4 checks, and [Bot #256](https://github.com/Life-USTC/bot/pull/256) at `3db7b3f9ae03973f88e6beb1248ee7caa907d417` after 6/6 checks. Both merged trees match their reviewed/tested heads. The canonical operation and legacy operation are present in both actual main contracts; the source pin is the real merged server commit and the exact API SHA-256 is `9df7dd68d6b4a62148d8b8f2164a507a613cf353eff65af261cd63a424a32217`. Existing repository provenance verifiers and exact Git blobs were checked, and both local main checkouts are clean and synchronized.

Independent source reviews and clean committed race/semantic validation passed. No ordinary immutable display flow, existing inline URL, legacy response, identifier schema, timeout or cache policy was reinterpreted. The canonical and legacy resource behavior was proven together through owned HTTP, including colliding IDs and trusted Demo isolation. This coordinated server/client issue is complete.

issue.title: fix(young): distinguish source membership from signup availability
issue.body:
## Problem

When an event has no upstream `status` label, the public list and detail use `isActive` to display “Open for signup / 报名中” or “Ended / 已结束”. However, `isActive` identifies source-list membership and does not establish a current registration phase. A current-list event can require no signup, open registration later, or have a closed registration window.

This is visible while validating #1536: sample `demo-young-13` has `requiresSignup: false` and no registration window, yet the list displays “Open for signup”. The fallback also affects ordinary records with the same facts.

The existing [signup-state requirement](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/ad105fee3538f200d5b9597c445824a5224656fa/docs/features/young-event.yaml) explicitly separates source-list membership from registration availability. [youngEventStatusLabel](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/ad105fee3538f200d5b9597c445824a5224656fa/src/features/young/lib/young-event-display.ts) currently falls back to the signup/ended labels.

## Acceptance

- Keep a real upstream status label when provided. When absent, describe current/historical source-list membership without claiming that signup is possible or the activity has ended.
- Preserve `isActive`, `requiresSignup`, registration codes/windows, source withdrawal and activity time as independent facts. Do not rewrite API data or infer cancellation from source absence.
- Keep the displayed status-column text and its Web filter semantics aligned, including localized fallback labels and ordinary upstream-label matches.
- Verify no-signup, future/closed registration windows and historical-list records, and retain ordinary list/detail/organizer/subscription behavior.
- Use matched native before/after evidence and necessary unit/browser checks; reuse the active worktree after the current Young slice is saved, without adding an acceptance framework.

issue.title: fix(rooms): avoid revalidating normalized codes as raw input
issue.body:
## Problem

The existing ordinary room-map REST adapter can return HTTP 500 for input accepted by its own declared schema. For example, `ﬄ` repeated 22 times has raw length 22 but normalizes to 66 ASCII letters. `Ⅷ` repeated 17 times similarly normalizes from 17 to 68 characters.

The current `roomCodeSchema` applies the 64-character limit before NFKC/uppercase. The adapter validates and transforms the input, then passes the transformed string into `getRoomMap`, which validates again; lookup can parse it again as well. A subsequent raw-length check throws instead of returning the supported unknown-room result. Direct execution of the existing REST adapter reproduced HTTP 500; no production request or database/upstream probe was made.

The new Demo adapter in #1544 had the same repeated-normalization risk and is being corrected there to preserve raw input after the adapter's validation. The inherited ordinary path remains separate.

## Acceptance

- Trace REST, GraphQL, MCP, Web, iCal and service callers and prevent transformed output from being incorrectly revalidated as a new raw input.
- Preserve the current accepted raw-input set, raw length limit, trim/NFKC/uppercase behavior, supported map lookup and protocol error semantics. Do not reject valid expanded input merely to avoid the 500.
- Invalid raw inputs still fail validation; full-width known room codes still resolve correctly; valid expanded unknown codes retain each interface's normal unknown-room result instead of throwing.
- Verify through real supported entrypoints with owned static inputs, retaining independent expected results, no unexpected writes, cleanup and relevant ordinary regressions.
- Independent review and current-head CI before delivery. Do not use a blanket catch or invented room result to hide an error.

## Confirmed call sites

The ordinary REST adapter, GraphQL input boundary and MCP input schema all pass normalized output to the service, which normalizes again before lookup. The service also reparses at lookup. Schedule and exam iCal builders similarly pass `safeParse(...).data` to a raw-input lookup. Web lookup links/submission and the shared preview normalize before sending the request, which can independently turn a valid raw input into an overlong request. These entrypoints must preserve the same accepted raw-input set; a service-only change would leave the browser defect in place.

The Demo adapter correction and its expanded-input HTTP checks remain in #1544; this issue covers the inherited ordinary paths. The response schema already accepts the normalized code as a string, so it does not need a new output-length restriction.

issue.title: test(calendar): complete teaching-week journey and final effects within native budget

## Acceptance

- Investigate redundant document loads and use actual existing navigation controls where that preserves the intended complete journey; otherwise restructure owned cases without losing representative journeys or assertions.
- Verify the affected real cases, independent review and full current-head CI before delivery. Preserve the original failed trace and distinguish executed checks from checks not reached.

Related: #1429 and the test modularity objective #1155.

issue.title: fix(logging): retain safe recognized transaction failure reasons
issue.body:
## Problem

The production trace for `GET /api/workspace/homeworks` at 2026-11-08 02:12:30.764 UTC returned HTTP 500 with `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` / `P2028`. Authentication took 16 ms, the read stage 2000 ms, and the feature operation 2017 ms. Seventeen correlated records retain no reason that distinguishes transaction startup, expiration or a closed transaction. Raw request data remains private.

`getSafeDatabaseErrorDetails` already preserves a valid structured execution-timeout diagnostic. Some other Prisma transaction reasons exist only in message fields that are correctly omitted from production logs. The duration alone is insufficient evidence to classify them. Related investigation: #1465; this request is a different path from the original exams incident and the scheduled capacity issue #1509.

## Acceptance

- Preserve the existing structured timeout evidence and its precedence.
- Recognize only bounded, exact known Prisma transaction templates, gated by P2028, and emit a closed set of content-free reason enums. Unrecognized or hostile values stay unknown; no duration-based inference.
- Never emit messages, SQL, transaction identifiers, credentials or request data. Do not invoke getters merely to inspect newly considered message fields; retain cycle/depth and failure protections.
- Validate recognized and unknown templates, structured precedence, unrelated error codes, private canaries and hostile accessors through the actual production serialization boundary.
- Independent review, necessary local checks and current-head CI before delivery. Do not change pool capacity, deadlines, retry policy or transaction behavior.

This repairs an observed diagnostic gap. It cannot recover discarded text from the retained trace, establish acquisition versus BEGIN timing, or close #1465 without further evidence.

issue.title: fix(young): distinguish source membership from signup availability
issue.body:
## Problem

When an event has no upstream `status` label, the public list and detail use `isActive` to display “Open for signup / 报名中” or “Ended / 已结束”. However, `isActive` identifies source-list membership and does not establish a current registration phase. A current-list event can require no signup, open registration later, or have a closed registration window.

This is visible while validating #1536: sample `demo-young-13` has `requiresSignup: false` and no registration window, yet the list displays “Open for signup”. The fallback also affects ordinary records with the same facts.

The existing [signup-state requirement](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/ad105fee3538f200d5b9597c445824a5224656fa/docs/features/young-event.yaml) explicitly separates source-list membership from registration availability. [youngEventStatusLabel](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/ad105fee3538f200d5b9597c445824a5224656fa/src/features/young/lib/young-event-display.ts) currently falls back to the signup/ended labels.

## Acceptance

- Keep a real upstream status label when provided. When absent, describe current/historical source-list membership without claiming that signup is possible or the activity has ended.
- Preserve `isActive`, `requiresSignup`, registration codes/windows, source withdrawal and activity time as independent facts. Do not rewrite API data or infer cancellation from source absence.
- Keep the displayed status-column text and its Web filter semantics aligned, including localized fallback labels and ordinary upstream-label matches.
- Verify no-signup, future/closed registration windows and historical-list records, and retain ordinary list/detail/organizer/subscription behavior.
- Use matched native before/after evidence and necessary unit/browser checks; reuse the active worktree after the current Young slice is saved, without adding an acceptance framework.

issue.title: feat(demo): support existing Young event and organizer browsing
issue.body:
## Problem

Demo 首页已有五条虚构活动摘要，但现有公开活动、日历及组织者页面仍被只读边界拒绝，摘要不能通向对应详情。补齐这些普通用户浏览路径，复用现有页面与 API，不创建独立演示工作台。

Part of #548.

## Scope and acceptance

- 现有活动列表、活动详情、活动日历、组织者目录和组织者详情，以及对应四个 JSON 读 API 和海报入口，均从同一个双语封闭样例图派生。Home 五条活动的既有 title/date/meta/key/crossDay=false 保留，链接改为对应的已知详情；列表、详情、组织者计数及日历相互一致。
- 复用现有筛选与分页契约，包括显示列筛选、同字段 OR/跨字段 AND、数量/日期操作、Web 多分类与 REST 原有单分类语义、报名/活动时间轴、未知日期、跨日活动、报名窗和撤源状态。提供足够记录，真实覆盖活动列表、组织者目录及组织者活动的既有 Web 续页；折叠或空状态不能代替分页。
- 固定上海时间为 `2026-09-24T09:00:00+08:00`，日历周日开始，保留 day/week/month 和公开日历自然整周边界。活动与报名时间不混淆，不把撤源当取消，不伪造真实采集新鲜度；来源明确标为固定虚构样例。
- 现有详情评论使用封闭的已知 young-event 目标和具名样例，保留只读线程、分页、反应计数及 permalink；真实 ID 不回落读取真实数据。
- 海报只服务当前样例图关联的本地固定内容；不访问真实图片代理、学校源站、数据库、缓存或 R2。服务端可信 Demo 早分流，未知目标拒绝，演示请求及响应保持 private/no-store。
- 订阅、组织者关注、提醒写入、管理和外部报名入口在 SSR 即禁用并解释原因；不制造真实 viewer。当前公开详情的订阅事实需有明确标识的固定只读样例呈现，不以一律隐藏代替。活动日历现有个人冲突展示从既有 Demo 教学日历纯图投影。若后续扩展个人订阅/通知工作台，需继续作为 #548 未完成范围单独交付，不以禁用替代该范围完成。
- 模式/语言切换、退出重入及旧请求晚到不会让真实数据或过期样例回写当前页面；正常匿名/真实用户行为保留。

## Validation

独立源码审查、必要单元与真实 REST/Web 消费者验证、匹配桌面/手机双语截图及当前 PR 完整 CI。复用现有测试设施与 worktree，临时证据放 `/tmp`，结论留在 PR/CI。保持生产 Demo 开关关闭；不包含生产发布。

issue.body:
建议优先级：**P1**。2026-11-04 Chrome 生产环境审计的后续修复；历史截图按原视口保留。 ## 复现与现象 - **P04 · 收起 sidebar 后，当前详情分支没有任何高亮**：在 /catalog/sections/181672 打开详情后收起侧栏，子节点被隐藏，主导航中没有任何 aria-current 或 data-active=true 链接。 - **P06 · 详情页只挂了一个叶子，没有完整的页面树和页内目录**：教学班侧栏只有“浏览教学班 → 计算机视觉”；简介、日历、考试、作业、评论都在一条很长的正文中，没有可见的页内跳转目录。正常教学班页面也没有清楚的所属课程链接。 - **P07 · 进入第二课堂/设置时整棵全站导航被替换**：其他模块使用全站 sidebar，进入第二课堂后只剩“返回首页、活动列表、活动日历、主办方”；设置也切换成独立导航。返回日历、课程或活动订阅需要额外绕路。 - **P17 · 同站详情页有两种滚动/页脚结构**：学术详情页标题固定、内部正文独立滚动，法律链接挪到 sidebar 底部；新闻和活动详情则有贯穿主内容底部的 footer。个人工作区又完全没有相同页脚。 - **D12 · 手机 sidebar 没有显式关闭按钮，辅助说明还是脚手架英文**：390px 点击“菜单”打开抽屉，不选择新页面，寻找关闭按钮。 抽屉宽约281px、占满844px高度；DOM中的 Close 按钮尺寸为0。当前焦点在 Logo。面板名称为 Sidebar，说明 Displays the mobile sidebar.。Escape 可以关闭（已验证），遮罩区仍提供退出方式，因此不是“无法退出”。 - 最初校车线路图测试中，收起侧栏后低频“应用/管理”也变成大量图标；展开恢复原分组状态，问题在折叠投影。 - 检查总览入口仅依赖logo、分组名/子项重名、账户入口分散、37/1/74等计数缺少可见口径。它们属于发现性设计问题；未验证所有tooltip，不能声明全部不存在。 - 主办方详情应进入“主办方 → 名称”当前路径；现有活动详情有叶节点而主办方没有（P14导航部分）。 - 验收同时覆盖展开、折叠、390px抽屉、键盘/读屏；当前详情祖先可辨、子页可切换、显式关闭及关闭后焦点恢复。 ## 已有工作与仍然存在的缺口 [#349](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/issues/349) / [PR #355](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/355) 增加二级菜单；[#350](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/issues/350) / [PR #356](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/356) 为修复折叠后点击不跳转，显式强制所有分组 open。[PR #1146](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/1146) 明确移除可见面包屑并为设置/第二课堂替换侧栏；[#1215](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/issues/1215) / [PR #1239](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/1239) 统一 destination registry 但保留这些 contextual sidebar。[#1244](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/issues/1244) 又将课程和活动按用户任务归组。 历史改动分别解决点击、分组和去重，但没有保证折叠后的可见祖先继承当前页状态，也没有保证进入子领域后仍能访问兄弟任务。强制展开分组还解释了折叠后图标反而变多。树可表达课程→教学班→作业/考试/课次，聚合入口应保留返回来源；教师/教室关联无需强塞进唯一父级。 历史还有直接反馈：PR #355 的[评论](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/355#issuecomment-4899527929)已经指出教学班、课程、教师详情的二级导航无法验证。此次仍需以真实详情路由验收祖先路径，不能只验证工作区二级菜单。 ## 验收 - [x] 展开时高亮当前叶节点并保留祖先路径；收起时把当前分支状态投射到可见父图标，保留 tooltip 和可访问名称。 - [x] 确定一个规范父级和面包屑，再将详情分节放到页内目录或树的下一层。教学班始终显示所属课程链接，教师、订阅和其他教学班作为关联入口。 - [x] 保持根节点和主要分支稳定；允许折叠兄弟分支，但不要换掉整棵树。若必须聚焦子树，应显式给出“全站 → 第二课堂”的祖先与退出聚焦操作。 - [x] 定义少量明确模板：集合、详情、设置、工具。页脚和主要滚动区域规则属于壳层，尽量统一；需要例外时按内容用途而非路由字符串决定。 - [x] 手机可见关闭入口、触控尺寸稳定、读屏名称明确；打开/关闭/导航后的焦点与滚动位置符合预期。 - [x] 保留匹配视口的前后截图，并针对本次失败条件增加回归；不以元素可见、等高或根页面无横滚替代内容可读性。 ## 代码定位 - [`src/lib/components/shell/AppSidebar.svelte:231`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/shell/AppSidebar.svelte#L231-L270) - [`src/lib/components/shell/shell-nav-helpers.ts:35`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/shell/shell-nav-helpers.ts#L35-L56) - [`src/features/section-detail/components/SectionDetailMainContent.svelte:162`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/features/section-detail/components/SectionDetailMainContent.svelte#L162-L197) - [`src/lib/components/shell/AppShell.svelte:439`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/shell/AppShell.svelte#L439-L447) - [`src/lib/components/shell/navigation.ts:484`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/shell/navigation.ts#L484-L515) - [`src/lib/components/shell/layout-shell.ts:22`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/shell/layout-shell.ts#L22-L29) - [`src/lib/components/shell/layout-shell.ts:59`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/shell/layout-shell.ts#L59-L67) - [`src/lib/components/ui/sidebar/sidebar.svelte:36`](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/blob/baa6d9d2d403064afaf7b5cb010e8fbce9283bec/src/lib/components/ui/sidebar/sidebar.svelte#L36-L60) ## 截图

截图中的个人账户字段已遮盖；原始截图保存在本地。源码引用审计检出 baa6d9d；复核 main 68a98d6 相比仅修改依赖清单，相关业务源码未变化。线上部署 SHA 未独立验证。审计未修改业务数据。 ## 交付与验收结果 - [PR #1481](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/1481) 已交付本地展开状态持久化、折叠祖先投影、主办方当前节点，以及本地化手机抽屉和显式关闭。 - [PR #1489](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/1489) 已在第二课堂与设置中保留全站主要分支，并处理当前节点在侧栏滚动区的可见性。 - [PR #1511](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/1511) 已交付学术详情面包屑、真实所属课程链接、页内目录与锚点恢复，以及按内容能力声明的壳层和法律入口。最终源码经过独立审查及真实 Worker 导航验证。 - [PR #1520](https://github.com/Life-USTC/server/pull/1520) 已交付明确入口、摘要计数口径和响应式单账户菜单，并修复晚到计数导致的手机当前项裁切与初次文字重叠。最终提交 `002a845` 经独立源审、配对图审、41项本地单元及21条真实Worker/浏览器控制验证，全部47项CI检查成功后合并为 `d36190a69b304b9c55ff2ab8794d26a9b615e9d3`。 原六项验收已完成：展开/折叠祖先、规范面包屑及真实关联、跨页面全站导航、按内容能力声明的模板/页脚、手机关闭与键盘焦点，以及匹配图片与内容可读性。固定延迟计数场景在保留的旧版本复现失败，新版本和最终CI原报告通过；原滚动、精确可见性、键盘与业务断言保留。各次交付的实际范围和证据集中在上述PR中。

issue.title: feat(demo): support the existing read-only Home page
issue.body:
让演示身份能够浏览现有首页，保留个人总览、校园速览、通知／活动摘要和功能目录，继续使用已交付的固定学业样例。目前演示边界拒绝首页；仅放开路径会使首页读取真实服务，不能作为完成。

验收：

- 现有首页 SSR、数据导航及 Home internal 读取使用可信演示身份的专用分支，返回私有、不可缓存的固定数据；业务读取不访问真实数据库、KV、R2 或外部提供商，普通用户分支保持原有行为。
- 个人总览从既有课程、作业、待办、考试与日历样例推导，身份、数量、教学周及参考时间跨页一致；不伪装真实 auth viewer，退出、历史返回与晚到响应不能恢复旧身份。
- 校园、通知和活动模块呈现明确标注为虚构的有效样例，不冒充学校通知、实况天气或真实班次；相对日期和时间统一依据演示参考时刻。
- 保留首页结构、目录和可浏览的已交付学业入口。尚未交付的新闻、公开活动、天气、校车及网站完整页面继续属于 #548，入口明确说明暂不可用；不能暗中跳回真实服务或另建演示工作台。
- 界面解释只读限制，置顶、写入、网站解析与外部跳转等未授权操作保持服务端拒绝；正常用户功能和权限不变。
- 通过真实 Worker 的 API／浏览器验证，覆盖双语、桌面／手机、数据一致性、身份隔离和普通用户兼容；保留同条件的前后截图。

首页交付后仍须继续完成 #548 的其余普通用户页面和全站验收；本项不启用生产演示开关。

issue.title: feat(demo): add read-only community discussion browsing
issue.body:
补齐 #548 中现有目录与作业讨论的只读浏览。目前 Demo 评论 API 始终为空，单条、回复与评论永久链接尚未开放。

验收：

- 复用现有评论界面及目标关系，共享一组具名虚构作者的双语固定样例。主课程有21个根评论、主线程11条回复，另为教学班、教师、教学班教师及作业各提供一个根评论；共25根、36节点。保持 active/public，固定参考时间、本地头像与 reaction 数，不模拟管理员或真实账户。
- 用现有 Web 每页20根、回复预览10条的真实控件完成两种继续加载；排序、root绑定 cursor、focused thread、页二评论及超预览回复的永久链接符合现有契约。课程及教学班课程讨论共享相同内容与计数，根总数不混入回复。
- 列表、单条、回复及永久链接在 trusted Demo 分流中读取固定数据；未知或混合目标、非法 cursor、失效或冲突身份不回落真实服务。读取保持 private/no-store，不查询真实用户、认证或业务数据库，不访问存储或外部服务。
- 发布、回复、编辑、删除与 reaction 写控件明确只读，服务端持续拒绝写入。固定 reaction 数仍可读，复制、定位、继续加载可用。沿用现有作者文字展示，不新增作者资料导航或开放真实 public-user 路由。
- 覆盖中英文、桌面及手机的真实浏览和匹配前后截图、正文可读性、身份切换/历史/迟到响应隔离；保留普通用户及 OAuth 评论行为，验证完整数据库快照及实际副作用边界。

不增加附件、外部图片或链接预览，不改变生产演示开关。本分片不代表整个 #548 完成。

Part of #548.

issue.title: test: cover retained demo and account contract gaps
issue.body:
手工对照 Demo、账户设置及其呈现规范时，发现现有测试尚不能守住以下已存在的契约。这些是断言缺口，暂未证实对应产品故障。

- 演示退出：与进入演示一样，验证缺失/跨源 Origin、编码路径别名被拒绝；拒绝不能清除有效身份或进入真实认证适配器。保留现有同源退出成功行为。
- 演示日历：每个视图除切换状态外，还检查实际日期边界和固定目标事件；移动月/学期检查真实日程范围，不把切换按钮选中当作内容正确。
- 安全会话列表：检查所有既有会话样例的 token 与非空原始 User-Agent 均未进入完整页面 DOM，同时保留所属用户、当前会话、日期、失败/重试和撤销语义。
- 设置导航：活动项及键盘聚焦项在水平、垂直方向都完全处于实际导航滚动窗口和浏览器视口内，保留现有路径、窄屏和键盘操作覆盖。

复用已有测试、独立样例和原生运行方式；不修改产品规则、超时、重试或减少已有断言。完成受影响验证、独立审查和当前提交完整 CI 后交付。仅覆盖本次明确发现的缺口，不代表整个测试迁移完成。

Part of #1155.
